title: 2012 Topps Chrome #122 Quinton Coples New York Jets Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 Topps Chrome sports trading card features Quinton Coples, a rookie player for the New York Jets in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 122. It is perfect for any football fan or collector looking to add to their collection. The card is manufactured by Topps and is from the 2012 season. 

In addition to the features of being a rookie card and part of the base set, it also has other attributes such as the type of card being a sports trading card and the category of trading card singles. It falls under the sports trading cards and sports memorabilia, cards, and fan shop categories. Add this card to your collection today!
